title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (145 affected)
summary: A PLASTIC FILLER PIECE LOCATED IN THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION WAS INSTALLED WITHOUT SUFFICIENT SUPPORT. THIS FILLER PIECE CAN MOVE BECAUSE OF THE HYDRAULIC PRESSURE IN THE SYSTEM, AND NOT ALLOW THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION TO KICK DOWN TO A LOWER GEAR.

title: IC CORPORATION: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY (200 affected)
summary: THE FUEL SYSTEM FAILED THE CRASH BARRIER TEST. THE FUEL TANK WAS PUNCTURED, RESULTING IN FLUID LOSS GREATER THAN ALLOWED BY FMVSS 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: LAG MOTORCOACH USA: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES AND FITTINGS (79 affected)
Ford Motor Company: ENGINE (48,000 affected)
summary: THE SOUND INSULATION ON THE ENGINE SIDE OF THE DASH PANEL CAN CONTACT THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: STEERING:LINKAGES (5,500 affected)
summary: THE CROSS STEERING LEVERS INTERCONNECTING THE LEFT AND RIGHT HAND STEERING KNUCKLES TO MAINTAIN ALIGNMENT WERE MANUFACTURED FROM INFERIOR MATERIALS AND FAIL IN LOW IMPACT SITUATIONS.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND FUSE RECEPTICLE (275 affected)
summary: A 150 AMP CIRCUIT BREAKER, OPTION 4362, HAS BEEN WIRED IN PARALLEL WITH A STANDARD EQUIPMENT CIRCUIT, THEREBY NOT PROVIDING THE REQUIRED PROTECTION.

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS (277 affected)
summary: THE POINTS OF THE RELAYS OF THE TURN SIGNAL SYSTEM FUSE TOGETHER DUE TO HIGH APPLIED CURRENT.

title: Adient, PLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY (9,318 affected)
summary: THE MANIFOLD HOLES OF THE BATTERIES WERE NOT PLUGGED AND COULD ALLOW HYDROGEN AND OXYGEN GAS TO ESCAPE IN AN UNCONTROLLED MANNER.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: FUEL:CARBURETION:INJECTORS:THROTTLE CONTROL AND LI (3,200 affected)
summary: A LEAK OF EITHER GASOLINE OR PROPANE CAN OCCUR IN COMPONENTS OF THE DUAL FUEL SYSTEM. THIS CONDITION IS PRIMARILY THE RESULT OF THE CONFIGURATION AND LOCATION OF COMPONENTS IN AREAS WHERE HIGH TEMPERATURES ARE BEING GENERATED BY THE ENGINE AND EXHAUST SYSTEMS.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (565,000 affected)
summary: THE RIGID MOUNTED SAFETY BELT BUCKLES ARE DEFECTIVE IN THREE WAYS. FIRST, A FASTENED SAFETY BELT BUCKLE WILL NOT UNLATCH WHEN THE RELEASE BUTTON IS DEPRESSED. THIS RESULTS FROM INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE BUCKLE EJECTOR FINGER AND THE BUCKLE TONGUE WINDOW. THE SECOND DEFECT IS THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE MAY NOT LATCH. THE THIRD POSSIBLE DEFECT IS THAT THE TONGUE MAY BE RETAINED BY THE BUCKLE, BUT IT MAY NOT BE LATCHED SUFFICIENTLY TO PROVIDE OCCUPANT PROTECTION.

title: Trailmobile Canada Limited: BRAKES:121 AIR SYSTEM (414 affected)
summary: THE TWO (2) RELAY SERVICE VALVES ARE CONNECTED TO THE SAME RESERVOIR RESULTING IN 4.25 TIMES, RATHER THAN 8 TIMES, THE COMBINED VOLUME OF ALL CHAMBERS AT MAXIMUM TRAVEL. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS."

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL SYSTEMS (22,000 affected)
summary: FATIGUE CRACKS CAN DEVELOP IN THE SOLDER JOINT BETWEEN THE FUEL RETURN TUBE AND THE FUEL PUMP SENDING UNIT LOCATED AT THE TOP OF THE FUEL TANK.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: POWER TRAIN:DRIVESHAFT (1 affected)
summary: THE DRIVESHAFT USED WITH SOME ENGINE/TRANSMISSION COMBINATIONS HAD INSUFFICIENT WELDS JOINING SOME OF THE COMPONENTS.

title: Ford Motor Company: EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (29,052 affected)
summary: THE TIRE CERTIFICATION LABELS INCORRECTLY IDENTIFY THE VEHICLE TIRE REQUIREMENTS AS P235/75R15 SL (STANDARD LOAD), RATHER THAN AS P235/75R15 XL (EXTRA LOAD).

title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (969,182 affected)
summary: THE RED SHOULDER STRAP RELEASE BUTTON CAN ROTATE OUT OF THE FRAME IN A CRASH OR SUDDEN STOP. IN THIS EVENT, THE RELEASE BUTTON COULD NOT BE ACTIVATED WITH LESS THAN 16 POUNDS OF FORCE AS REQUIRED BY FMVSS 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS".

title: FISHER-PRICE, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (423,900 affected)
summary: PLASTIC LAMINATE ON THE BUCKLE SHIELD CAN BREAK AFTER FORCE IS APPLIED IN REPEATED USE.

title: FISHER-PRICE, INC.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (472,000 affected)
summary: THE SHOULDER BELTS ON CAR SEATS USING A PARTICULAR DESIGN OF CONNECTOR BAR CAN COME FREE OF THE CONNECTOR BAR AFTER EXTENDED USE.
